rules.statement: Nothing happens without leaving an observable project event.
Before modifying anything: READ -> UNDERSTAND -> DIFF -> PLAN -> PATCH -> VERIFY -> COMMIT. Never rewrite an entire project.
Create a checkpoint before any operation that can destroy previous state.
Check package compatibility before installation. Born from a dependency-conflict lesson.
The core engine must run with an empty node_modules. External frameworks are optional adapters.
Ask 'what do we already know?' before asking 'what must I do?'.
The system documents itself. Never depend on the human remembering to say 'now document this'.
Code identifiers in English; comments trilingual and pedagogical, written as a course for absolute beginners.
Store a Decision Trace (objective, context, constraints, alternatives, decision, justification, action, result, verification, learning). Never attempt to transcribe a model's private reasoning.
Work proceeds through layers 0-10 in order; the agent does not jump arbitrarily between them.

The console is an installable PWA usable with AND without connection. Every view must render from the live API, from the service-worker cache, or from the bundled snapshot, in that order. The interface must always flag the active mode and the sync time: stale data is never presented as fresh. No new npm dependency may be introduced to achieve this.

decisions.justification: A PWA is the only option that installs on desktop and mobile, works offline, keeps zero dependencies and needs no build step. The service worker turns "offline" from an error into a mode with real data, and the snapshot makes even the first offline boot useful.
decisions.consequence: apps/console gains sw.js, manifest.webmanifest, icons/ (generated by scripts/generate-icons.js) and snapshot.json (generated by scripts/export-console-snapshot.js). POL-0011 now forbids shipping a view that cannot render from cache or snapshot. Regenerating the snapshot is part of the release ritual.
decisions.evidence: curl: /manifest.webmanifest -> application/manifest+json; /sw.js -> no-cache; /snapshot.json -> 74 frozen API responses; icons are valid PNGs (192/512/maskable) produced by a dependency-free encoder.

requirements.title: Separate data into five levels (raw / processed / knowledge / project / control)
requirements.acceptance: The five physical directories exist and no level writes into another.

requirements.title: Store explainable Decision Traces instead of private model reasoning
requirements.acceptance: Each decision records objective, context, constraints, alternatives, decision, justification, consequence and status.

requirements.title: Treat interruptions ('cortes') as first-class events
requirements.acceptance: Interruption events carry type, layer, task, reason, impact, recoverability and recovery plan.

requirements.title: Work fully offline with zero npm dependencies in the core
requirements.acceptance: npm install is never required to run init/capture/process/search/context/serve.

requirements.title: Web app that is simultaneously full-featured and offline-capable
requirements.acceptance: Zero-dep console works with no node_modules; Next.js app consumes the same API.

requirements.title: Trilingual pedagogical code comments (ES/EN/PT) written as a beginner course
requirements.acceptance: Every source file has a trilingual header plus a BEGINNER COURSE block.

requirements.title: Generate a Reverse Engineering Curriculum from real builds
requirements.acceptance: A completed build can be turned into lesson + concepts + tutorial + exercise + solution.

requirements.title: Autonomous agent with context, planner, executor, verifier and recovery
requirements.acceptance: genesis resume rebuilds session context and continues the last task.

requirements.title: Never overwrite: snapshot, diff, patch, verify, rollback
requirements.acceptance: Checkpoints can restore control state and are created before risky mutations.

requirements.title: El sistema debe conservar absolutamente todo lo ocurrido en el nivel RAW sin interpretarlo.
requirements.acceptance: Pending: define a measurable acceptance criterion.

requirements.title: El sistema debe separar los datos en cinco niveles: raw, processed, knowledge, project y control.
requirements.acceptance: Pending: define a measurable acceptance criterion.

requirements.title: El nivel CONTROL debe permitir que otra sesión no tenga que releer todo el universo.
requirements.acceptance: Pending: define a measurable acceptance criterion.

requirements.title: La aplicación debe funcionar de forma totalmente offline y a la vez ser completa.
requirements.acceptance: Verifiable: works with no network access and an empty node_modules.

requirements.title: Los comentarios del código deben ser trilingües (ES/EN/PT) con explicación de curso para principiantes.
requirements.acceptance: Verifiable: the artifact exposes content in es, en and pt.

requirements.title: Nunca se debe sobrescribir un archivo sin READ → UNDERSTAND → DIFF → PLAN → PATCH → VERIFY → COMMIT.
requirements.acceptance: Pending: define a measurable acceptance criterion.

entity.context: The user asked for the app to work on desktop AND mobile, offline AND online (both modes). The console was already a zero-dependency web app served by genesis serve, but it was not installable and it died when the API was unreachable.
entity.decision: Ship the console as an installable PWA: web manifest + generated PNG icons + service worker with per-resource cache strategies (cache-first shell, network-first API with last-good fallback) + a bundled snapshot.json so a never-connected install still opens with real data. One responsive codebase (drawer + bottom tabs on mobile, sidebar on desktop) covers both form factors. The UI always displays the active mode (live / cached / snapshot) and the sync time.
entity.justification: A PWA is the only option that installs on desktop and mobile, works offline, keeps zero dependencies and needs no build step. The service worker turns "offline" from an error into a mode with real data, and the snapshot makes even the first offline boot useful.
entity.consequence: apps/console gains sw.js, manifest.webmanifest, icons/ (generated by scripts/generate-icons.js) and snapshot.json (generated by scripts/export-console-snapshot.js). POL-0011 now forbids shipping a view that cannot render from cache or snapshot. Regenerating the snapshot is part of the release ritual.
entity.evidence: curl: /manifest.webmanifest -> application/manifest+json; /sw.js -> no-cache; /snapshot.json -> 74 frozen API responses; icons are valid PNGs (192/512/maskable) produced by a dependency-free encoder.
constraints: POL-0001: zero npm dependencies in the core, fully offline
No build step allowed for the offline console
One codebase must serve desktop and mobile
Stale data may be shown but must always be flagged as stale

alternatives.option: Electron desktop app + Cordova/Capacitor mobile wrapper
alternatives.rejected_because: Bundles Chromium/native toolchains and hundreds of npm packages; breaks POL-0001 and the empty-node_modules acceptance test, and triples repo size.
Requires a Rust toolchain on every machine that builds the app; the project must run on a bare Node 22 install.

alternatives.option: Plain website without service worker, showing "you are offline" when the API dies
alternatives.rejected_because: Fails the explicit requirement of being usable without connection; an error screen is not a mode.

alternatives.option: Installable PWA (manifest + service worker + bundled snapshot.json) with a three-tier data layer: live API -> service-worker cache -> snapshot

entity.content:
No construiría esto como una simple "app que muestra el chat". Lo convertiría en un
sistema de documentación, trazabilidad, aprendizaje y ejecución del proyecto, donde
cada conversación se transforma en conocimiento estructurado y cada nueva sesión
puede continuar desde ese estado.

La arquitectura correcta es: Chat → Captura → Normalización → Análisis → Grafo de
conocimiento → Documentación → Aplicación → Agente → Ejecución → Verificación →
Aprendizaje → actualización del sistema.

Requisitos que debe cumplir:

- El sistema debe conservar absolutamente todo lo ocurrido en el nivel RAW sin interpretarlo.
- El sistema debe separar los datos en cinco niveles: raw, processed, knowledge, project y control.
- El nivel CONTROL debe permitir que otra sesión no tenga que releer todo el universo.
- La aplicación debe funcionar de forma totalmente offline y a la vez ser completa.
- Los comentarios del código deben ser trilingües (ES/EN/PT) con explicación de curso para principiantes.
- Nunca se debe sobrescribir un archivo sin READ → UNDERSTAND → DIFF → PLAN → PATCH → VERIFY → COMMIT.

DECISION TRACE DEC-00012

Objective:
Deliver the application usable on desktop and mobile, with and without internet connection, without adding dependencies.

Context:
The user asked for the app to work on desktop AND mobile, offline AND online (both modes). The console was already a zero-dependency web app served by genesis serve, but it was not installable and it died when the API was unreachable.

Constraints:
- POL-0001: zero npm dependencies in the core, fully offline
- No build step allowed for the offline console
- One codebase must serve desktop and mobile
- Stale data may be shown but must always be flagged as stale

Alternatives considered:
A. Electron desktop app + Cordova/Capacitor mobile wrapper  (rejected: Bundles Chromium/native toolchains and hundreds of npm packages; breaks POL-0001 and the empty-node_modules acceptance test, and triples repo size.)
B. Tauri (Rust) shell  (rejected: Requires a Rust toolchain on every machine that builds the app; the project must run on a bare Node 22 install.)
C. Plain website without service worker, showing "you are offline" when the API dies  (rejected: Fails the explicit requirement of being usable without connection; an error screen is not a mode.)
D. Installable PWA (manifest + service worker + bundled snapshot.json) with a three-tier data layer: live API -> service-worker cache -> snapshot  ← SELECTED

Decision:
Ship the console as an installable PWA: web manifest + generated PNG icons + service worker with per-resource cache strategies (cache-first shell, network-first API with last-good fallback) + a bundled snapshot.json so a never-connected install still opens with real data. One responsive codebase (drawer + bottom tabs on mobile, sidebar on desktop) covers both form factors. The UI always displays the active mode (live / cached / snapshot) and the sync time.

Justification:
A PWA is the only option that installs on desktop and mobile, works offline, keeps zero dependencies and needs no build step. The service worker turns "offline" from an error into a mode with real data, and the snapshot makes even the first offline boot useful.

Consequence:
apps/console gains sw.js, manifest.webmanifest, icons/ (generated by scripts/generate-icons.js) and snapshot.json (generated by scripts/export-console-snapshot.js). POL-0011 now forbids shipping a view that cannot render from cache or snapshot. Regenerating the snapshot is part of the release ritual.

Status: APPROVED
